create_corpus_from_data: create a Corpus object from a list of data instances
read_word_based_corpus: read a word-based corpus from a text file and return a Corpus object
read_character_based_corpus: read a character-based corpus from a text file and return a Corpus object
get_batches: get batches from a corpus with configurable episodic or non-episodic mode
get_episodic_batches: get episodic batches from an instance generator with conditioning support
